meta.title: feat: add comprehensive getSlots performance tests for complex team scenarios
meta.body_summary: Add a comprehensive performance test suite for the getSlots logic with complex team scenarios, measuring slot generation latency and comparing before/after an optimization.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added comprehensive getSlots performance tests with detailed analysis; PR closed by maintainer without review feedback after ~14h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1519 changed lines, this is a medium-sized test addition by absolute volume, though most churn is in the new test file (617 lines). The PR was closed without merge despite detailed performance claims, likely due to lack of maintainer engagement.
